pages.text: Wireless energy, the ultimate romance of ditching all the wires.$(br)Enclose a 5×5×5 sealed box with terminal casings, place terminal blocks, controller, and safety blocks on the walls, and put 1 Wireless Terminal Core at the center of the cavity.$(br)The terminal auto-binds a nearby formed Energy Cell Serializer as the network's storage hub.

Register an Identity Card on the terminal's "Security" page, then hold that same card and right-click an input/output port to bind it.$(br)Cross-dim components unlock cross-dimension transfer, chunk-loader frames weakly load network chunks, and loss-suppression components cut transmission loss.$(br2)Laying pipes? Not anymore — now you pull power straight out of thin air.
